errors.description: Chapter V (ARREST OF PERSONS) has no heading in the body print; mapped from Arrangement of Sections (page 4) at section 35

India Code body omits the clause "shall, in the absence of any reasonable excuse, the burden of proving which excuse shall lie" in sub-section (1)(xii); section text reconstructed from the Gazette of India as-enacted print (250884_2_english_01042024.pdf).

India Code body print ends section 215 after sub-section (1) and omits sub-sections (2), (3) and (4) (cross-referenced elsewhere in the Act as sub-section (4) of section 215); section text reconstructed from the Gazette of India as-enacted print (250884_2_english_01042024.pdf).
